description: This Swift source file defines the `AnyCodable` struct, a lightweight wrapper that conforms to `Codable` allowing heterogeneous JSON payloads to be encoded and decoded. It handles various primitive types, dictionaries, arrays, and null values, providing custom encoding/decoding logic and equality/hash implementations.
